name: Holds Access Analyzer Finding
description: An IAM Access Analyzer analyzer holds one of its active findings (analyzer -> finding): a finding accessanalyzer:ListFindings (external-access analyzers) or ListFindingsV2 (the others) returned, filtered to status ACTIVE on the run's own account's resources, and capped. Containment: the analyzer declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES. Its one surface per analyzer records the filter with no positive control and any truncation, so it is never complete and never nominates a retirement. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
